attributes.text: Hi, I'm the independent developer behind Resolve Community and AwayDoomscrollin'.
attributes.originalText: Hi, I'm the independent developer behind Resolve Community and AwayDoomscrollin'.

attributes.text: During the COVID-19 pandemic, I started spending almost all day on my computer or phone. Life outside felt complicated. Gaming or scrolling for hours felt easier and safer than socializing. Looking back, I think I was trying to escape real life.
attributes.originalText: During the COVID-19 pandemic, I started spending almost all day on my computer or phone. Life outside felt complicated. Gaming or scrolling for hours felt easier and safer than socializing. Looking back, I think I was trying to escape real life.

attributes.text:
I realized that short-content habits were taking more time and attention than I wanted.

I wanted a clearer boundary that would help me get back to my studies and my goals.

attributes.text: Why did I build this app under Resolve Community?
attributes.originalText: Why did I build this app under Resolve Community?

attributes.text: Even when I was busy with something else, I'd find myself opening short videos without thinking. I built AwayDoomscrollin' under Resolve Community to create a clear boundary that holds even on tired days. I use it myself, and it keeps improving through testing and feedback from people who use it.
